resources.name: Quantum ESPRESSO (or other open-source plane-wave DFT code)

access.notes: Any recent version supporting PAW/PBE and spin-polarized calculations is acceptable.
Must include PAW datasets for Sr, Mn, Ge, S, O, K, La with PBE.
Space group P-42_1 m, lattice constants a=b=9.5206 Å, c=12.4004 Å, atomic positions provided in the task description.
